name: ATLANTIS FPGA Volume Rendering Architecture
definition: A hardware system for volume rendering that uses FPGA reconfiguration to define special-purpose processors for different operations, minimizing hardware by reloading configuration for different computing tasks.
summary: ATLANTIS is a hybrid FPGA/RISC volume rendering system that reconfigures FPGAs on-the-fly to maximize throughput and minimize hardware footprint for specific rendering tasks.
